column5: phenotype_by_chrom: chr22 slice of the tabix BED; deterministic.
phenotype_by_chrom_2: per-chrom (#id, #dir) manifest; dir column -> normalize_paths=True.
phenotype_by_chrom_2: region-list; trailing path column -> normalize_paths=True.
phenotype_by_region_2: per-region (#id, dir) manifest; dir column -> normalize_paths=True.
gct_extract_samples: GCT filtered to keep_samples.txt; deterministic, no embedded paths.
phenotype_annotate_by_tad: phenotype-per-TAD region list; trailing path column (phenoFile) -> normalize_paths=True.
phenotype_by_chrom_gct: chr22 GCT with 3 coord cols blanked (legacy awk); deterministic, no embedded paths.
